A notarized affidavit on a 100/- non-judicial stamp pa per declaring the same must be uploaded with the bid. The Bidder firm/company must submit a bank solve ncy certificate/Banker's certificate from their respective bankers for an amount of Rs 20,00,000 (Twenty La khs). The Bidder should submit compliance of product specifications as details in the bid. The bidder shall upload a valid ISO 3834 certificate for the supply of similar items. The bidder shall upload a valid ISO 5000 1 certificate for the supply of similar items. The bidder shall upload a valid ISO 1090 certificate for the supp ly of similar items. The bidder must submit proof of registration under the State Professional Tax. The bidd er must submit an undertaking on their official letterhead confirming that the scope of supply and bid price includes all cost components for the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of goods at different l ocations within the DMC area as per the buyer's choice. The bidder must have a functional office located in the state of the consignee. A declaration/undertaking along with valid documentary proof must be submitt ed on the bidder's official letter head. The bidder must submit a valid character certificate issued by the S. P. or D.C. The bidder must submit a valid Electrical Contractor License. The bidder shall provide a warranty for a minimum of 1 year from the date of successful installation, covering all parts of the supplied items. A notarized undertaking to this effect on a 100/-non-judicial stamp paper must be submitted along with the b id. .
